title: Smoky Trout Tagliatelle
subtitle: with broccoli, peas & flaked almonds
description: Who can say no to a big bowl of creamy delicious pasta? This creamy tagliatelle entangled with smoked trout and served with charred broccoli, is quick to make but it will keep you happy and nourished for much, much longer.
wine_pairing: Anthonij Rupert | L'Ormarins Blanc de Blancs

instructions.title: ROLLING PASTA
instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil for the pasta. When the water is boiling, cook the pasta for 8-10 minutes until al dente. Drain on completion, reserving 200ml of the pasta water. Toss through some oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: PLUMP PEAS
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Submerge the peas in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion.

instructions.title: FLAKY ALMONDS
instructions.text: Place the flaked almonds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until golden brown, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan on completion.

instructions.title: CHARRED BROC
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the broccoli pieces for 4-5 minutes until slightly charred and cooked through. Season, remove from the pan and cover to keep warm.

instructions.title: ALMOST THERE
instructions.text: Return the pan to a medium-high heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, sauté the diced onion for 3-5 minutes until soft, shifting frequently. Stir in the reserved pasta water, the crème fraîche, the mustard, and some lemon juice (to taste). Reduce the heat and leave to simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in the peas, the chopped smoked trout, the cooked pasta, and ½ the fresh chopped dill. Season and toss to combine. Add a splash of water if the sauce is too thick. Remove from the heat.

instructions.title: VOILA CHEF
instructions.text: Plate up the creamy tagliatelle with smoked trout and serve the charred broccoli on the side. Sprinkle over the flaked almonds and the remaining chopped dill. Enjoy Chef!

chef_tip: Mixing pasta water into your sauce is a great way to enhance it! The starch content adds a silky richness to the texture and the salt content lends extra flavour.
